decisions.reason: The sewer pipe cleaning box builds directly on the firm's fluid-handling fabrication for utilities, so it likely meets aspirations at low added cost in a growing industry.

Public waste bins are distant from the core offer and their results are uncertain, but they still serve existing public-sector buyers, so with limited slack and no clear shortfall there is no trigger for problemistic search to drop them yet.
Ground sleeves for posts fit the firm's metal fabrication and coating skills and need few dedicated resources, so keeping them is the satisficing choice.

Cast iron sleeves extend the ground sleeve line for municipal customers, though cast iron is less central to the firm's steel expertise, so overlap with the other sleeve variants makes later pruning slightly more likely.
Steel ground sleeves draw directly on the firm's core steel processing and surface treatment, making them the most aligned and lowest-risk variant to retain.
